capabilities: Render a kanban board of vault tasks from a dot-kanban code block
Drag cards between status columns to rewrite the task's checkbox in its note
Set priority and deadline and open the task's note from a card
Group, order and color columns and cards by owner or property
Add tasks to a chosen note, using the Tasks edit window when installed
extras: Documentation is written in French (interface in English and French); macOS, Windows and mobile are not yet validated, only Linux. Formerly named Tasks in Kanban, with a migration note.
intentEvidence: s'il est installé, le tableau sait aussi terminer une tâche récurrente et ouvrir sa fenêtre d'édition
problem: Obsidian shows tasks only as checkbox lists inside notes, with no board view to move tasks between statuses visually.

relations.evidence: Les priorités, dates et récurrences s'écrivent comme dans le module Tasks

summary: Code-block kanban board that shows the vault's tasks as one column per checkbox status and rewrites the task line when a card is dragged.
